user.title: Configure COP Calculator
user.description: Set up energy monitoring for your heat pump. Select the sensors that measure electrical consumption and thermal production.

data_description.name: Display name for the heat pump device
data_description.electrical_entity: Sensor that measures the electrical energy consumption (or power) of the heat pump
data_description.electrical_sensor_type: Choose whether the sensor reports cumulative energy (kWh) or instantaneous power (kW)
data_description.thermal_entity: Sensor that measures the thermal energy production (or power) of the heat pump
data_description.thermal_sensor_type: Choose whether the sensor reports cumulative energy (kWh) or instantaneous power (kW)
data_description.averaging_period: Time window (in minutes) for calculating the current COP. Longer periods smooth out delays between electrical input and thermal output.

pricing.title: Electricity Pricing
pricing.description: Optionally configure electricity pricing to calculate costs and savings.

data_description.price_type: Choose how electricity price is determined
data_description.electricity_price: Fixed price per kWh in EUR (e.g. 0.30)
data_description.electricity_price_entity: Sensor providing dynamic electricity price (e.g. from Tibber or aWATTar)

error.same_entity: Electrical and thermal sensors must be different entities
